family: D — BINARY LATENT FACTORIZATION (LittleBit / NanoQuant class)
verdict: ADMITTED. Not rejected by arithmetic. Its theoretical ceiling at matched rate BEATS PQ's measured error by a wide margin, so it earns the fitting effort S014 asks for.

method.breakeven_rank: W ~ U_b S V_b^T costs m*r + n*r + r*scale_bits bits, so at rate R over m*n weights, r* = m*n*R/(m+n+scale_bits). Pure arithmetic, no fitting.
method.why_the_bound_is_valid: A rank-r factorization of ANY kind cannot beat the best rank-r approximation, and the best is the truncated SVD. So sqrt(1 - SVD energy at r*) is a LOWER BOUND on the relative error this family can achieve at that rate -- reachable only with real singular vectors, never with sign-only factors.
method.why_it_is_generous: Binary factors carry sign plus one shared scale per component. A family that fails its own upper bound cannot be rescued by a better fitter. This admits, it does not promise.

best_possible_rel_error_by_rate.note: BEST POSSIBLE for any rank-r* factorization. Binary latent will be worse.

BINARY LATENT at 0.50.rel_error_BOUND_not_achieved: 0.556 to 0.581 across the three routed projections

matched_rate_comparison_against_family_A.reading: The binary-latent CEILING at 0.50 bits/weight is 0.556-0.581, while PQ's MEASURED error at a comparable-or-higher rate is 0.727-0.742. That is a gap of roughly 0.17 in relative error at matched rate. The gap is large enough that even a binary fitter losing a substantial fraction of the ideal could still beat PQ.
matched_rate_comparison_against_family_A.what_would_falsify_this: A binary-latent fit that lands near 0.73 or worse at 0.50 bits/weight. Then the sign-only penalty consumes the entire headroom and Family A stands.

other_findings: ATTENTION IS MORE LOW-RANK THAN THE EXPERTS. attn_o has effective rank 566 of 2048 (0.28) against routed_down's 622 of 1408 (0.44), and its bound at 1.0 bits/weight is 0.2005 versus the experts' 0.28-0.30. If any organ should get a low-rank representation it is the attention writer -- which is also only 2.33% of the language tower, so the EBPW prize there is small even though the fit would be good.

routed_up IS THE OUTLIER AMONG THE EXPERT PROJECTIONS. Stable rank 257.4 against gate's 100.7 and down's 97.2, and the worst bound at every rate. gravity_potency's organ_inversion prior says gate/up is the SENSITIVE organ and down tolerates more; this is an independent structural reason to treat up separately, though it is a different statement -- that prior is about capability damage, this is about representability.

AT 2.0 BITS/WEIGHT THE FAMILY IS DEGENERATE ON EXPERTS. r*/full reaches 1.18, meaning the rate buys more rank than the matrix has. Binary latent is a SUB-BIT-REGIME family here, not a general-purpose codec -- which is the regime this campaign is in.
not_established: No binary latent has been FITTED. Every number above is a bound, and the whole point of a bound is that it is not a result.
The bound assumes one scale per component (16 bits). Per-row scales, rotations or ITQ alignment change the arithmetic and must be re-derived, not assumed to be free.
Measured on ONE layer (11) and expert 0. gravity_potency records that expert statistics vary; a single specimen is not the bank.
Reconstruction error is not capability (CANON L17.9).
